en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a public square with trees, historic multi-story buildings, and a fountain at the center. The buildings exhibit classic European architectural styles and there is a visible street sign labeled 'NORRAL.' The front is captioned 'Sundsvall. Vängåvan.' The reverse side has handwritten correspondence in Russian and Swedish, plus Swedish stamps and a Stockholm, Sweden address.
